mentions.name: Pretty Good Music
mentions.description: This app is a music player, organizer, and discovery tool that loads listening history and subscriptions from streaming services, Discogs, Last.fm, and similar services, and lets users query their music data with AI. It is a work in progress.
mentions.source_excerpt: Music player, organizer, discovery tool that will load history and subscriptions from streaming services and discogs, last.fm etc and allow you to query it with AI.

evidence.value: Music player, organizer, discovery tool that will load history and subscriptions from streaming services and discogs, last.fm etc and allow you to query it with AI.

mentions.name: Pretty Good Music
mentions.description: Music player that organizes album collections from different services such as Spotify, Apple Music, Bandcamp, and Discogs, and shows detailed, high-quality information about albums that can be searched and filtered.
